586c2990cfc1f02fe44c648d0a0f9171.t: The first kernel computes the attention output for an entire sequence within a single SM, ensuring high throughput for fully occupied waves
586c2990cfc1f02fe44c648d0a0f9171.z: 第一个内核在单个SM内计算整个序列的注意力输出，确保完全占用的波次具有高吞吐量。

a0718250d5ab544a80c09fc74e024570.t: Therefore, we replace it end-to-end with DeepGEMM (Zhao et al
a0718250d5ab544a80c09fc74e024570.z: 因此，我们端到端地将其替换为DeepGEMM（Zhao等人）。

4c0ce24ef4fecd4df98afdfd6375bd7b.t: Traditional cuBLAS library (NVIDIA Corporation, 2024) cannot achieve batch invariance
4c0ce24ef4fecd4df98afdfd6375bd7b.z: 传统的cuBLAS库（NVIDIA公司，2024年）无法实现批次不变性。

9a7d8f3a111e776bef3417dc5fab59ce.t: Furthermore, for very small batch sizes, conventional implementation usually employs split-k (Osama et al
9a7d8f3a111e776bef3417dc5fab59ce.z: 此外，对于极小的批次规模，传统实现通常采用split-k方法（Osama等人

addf13eaa4efaf20e92d5949fa808d6a.t: Unfortunately, split-k techniques cannot guarantee batch invariance, a pivotal feature in DeepSeek-V4
addf13eaa4efaf20e92d5949fa808d6a.z: 遗憾的是，分割K技术无法保证批次不变性，而这是DeepSeek-V4中的一个关键特性。

d015ecb2129b956d221ad9ab843e5f88.t: Therefore, we abandon split-k in most scenarios, which, however, may cause performance degradation
d015ecb2129b956d221ad9ab843e5f88.z: 因此，在大多数场景下我们弃用split-k，但这可能导致性能下降。

eae0b33a8b1fd8180284ef530665c392.z: 此问题主要发生在反向传播过程中，尤其是在以下部分：

15acef28e38c038b4d044a98ee099bae.t: To address this, we introduce a set of optimizations that enable our implementation of matrix multiplication to match or even surpass the performance of standard split-k in most major scenarios
15acef28e38c038b4d044a98ee099bae.z: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了一系列优化措施，使我们的矩阵乘法实现在大多数主要场景下能够达到甚至超越标准split-k的性能。

45c785e3564088489babf77e07127c70.t: In conventional implementations of backward propagation for sparse attention, we use atomicAdd to accumulate gradients for the KV tokens
45c785e3564088489babf77e07127c70.z: 在稀疏注意力的反向传播常规实现中，我们使用atomicAdd来累积KV令牌的梯度。

f4668b3c60502a9d1448f6f6f044ba8e.t: Non-determinism in training typically stems from non-deterministic accumulation order, often due to the use of atomic addition instructions
f4668b3c60502a9d1448f6f6f044ba8e.z: 训练中的非确定性通常源于非确定性的累加顺序，这往往是由于使用了原子加法指令所致。

3dc96f8ff678f4b86bdff441abd72561.t: Moreover, when training exhibits anomalies such as loss spikes, determinism enables researchers to more easily pinpoint numerical causes and further refine the model design
3dc96f8ff678f4b86bdff441abd72561.z: 此外，当训练出现如损失尖峰等异常时，确定性使研究人员能更轻松地定位数值原因，并进一步优化模型设计。

980dcc2491d2e59a2b3378bf6ee157d7.t: Deterministic training is highly beneficial for debugging hardware or software issues
980dcc2491d2e59a2b3378bf6ee157d7.z: 确定性训练对调试硬件或软件问题非常有益。

072c53b4720cd1c723b0a1b3d8c4a46f.t: This introduces non-determinism due to the non-associativity of floating-point addition
072c53b4720cd1c723b0a1b3d8c4a46f.z: 这引入了非确定性，因为浮点加法不满足结合律。

d2af526658119a7eac921764a65f3927.t: When multiple SMs from different ranks concurrently write data to the same buffer on a receiving rank, negotiating writing positions also introduces non-determinism
d2af526658119a7eac921764a65f3927.z: 当来自不同rank的多个SM并发向接收rank上的同一缓冲区写入数据时，协商写入位置也会引入非确定性。

4f6e29a349490e4ca0fccd8c23dd51dd.t: This strategy ensures determinism of both the send results of expert parallelism and the accumulation order in the MoE backward pass
4f6e29a349490e4ca0fccd8c23dd51dd.z: 该策略确保了专家并行发送结果及MoE反向传播中累加顺序的确定性。

0b9f26d3c07d4c730cfdf23dc476c3e3.t: To address this problem, we allocate separate accumulation buffers for each SM, followed by a global deterministic summation across all buffers
0b9f26d3c07d4c730cfdf23dc476c3e3.z: 为解决此问题，我们为每个SM分配独立的累加缓冲区，随后对所有缓冲区进行全局确定性求和。

e33bcbc66269e1bb124e3956dd61adb3.t: , 2023) algorithm, whose naive implementation will cause non-determinism
e33bcbc66269e1bb124e3956dd61adb3.z: 2023年）算法，其朴素实现会导致非确定性

ef0c40da0a8df095849144c49ec4fb4d.t: mHC involves a matrix multiplication with an output dimension of only 24
ef0c40da0a8df095849144c49ec4fb4d.z: mHC涉及一次矩阵乘法，其输出维度仅为24。

37bc9a7aafe0aa56d6a5bac241016ca2.t: To resolve this, we design a token order pre-processing mechanism within each single rank, combined with buffer isolation across multiple ranks
37bc9a7aafe0aa56d6a5bac241016ca2.z: 为解决此问题，我们在每个单秩内部设计了一种令牌顺序预处理机制，并结合跨多秩的缓冲区隔离。

260b3c000957f0e81cec07d027f86115.t: For very small batch sizes, we are compelled to use the split-k (Osama et al
260b3c000957f0e81cec07d027f86115.z: 对于极小的批次规模，我们不得不采用split-k方法（Osama等人）。

48c955d1834c0ce5c885b060cca18cd8.t: To overcome this, we output each split part separately and perform a deterministic reduction in a subsequent kernel, thereby preserving both performance and determinism
48c955d1834c0ce5c885b060cca18cd8.z: 为克服这一问题，我们分别输出每个分割部分，并在后续内核中执行确定性归约，从而兼顾性能与确定性。

ca077d1414b801e037ca6eb6a0716f20.t: The Muon optimizer requires the full gradient matrix to compute parameter updates, which presents a challenge when combined with the Zero Redundancy Optimizer (ZeRO) (Rajbhandari et al
ca077d1414b801e037ca6eb6a0716f20.z: Muon优化器需要完整的梯度矩阵来计算参数更新，这在与零冗余优化器（ZeRO）结合时带来了挑战。

ab2c2ec016292944198e7e7d2885c321.t: To address this conflict, we design a hybrid strategy of ZeRO bucket assignment for Muon
ab2c2ec016292944198e7e7d2885c321.z: 为解决这一冲突，我们设计了一种针对Muon的ZeRO桶分配混合策略。

af393ace04f84b14a8328a8bca9f9c6e.t: Traditional ZeRO is designed for element-wise optimizers like AdamW, where a single parameter matrix can be partitioned and updated across multiple ranks
af393ace04f84b14a8328a8bca9f9c6e.z: 传统ZeRO针对逐元素优化器（如AdamW）设计，其中单个参数矩阵可跨多个秩进行分区和更新。

a9b331777be75f079bbdc0ec0919ca99.t: Our training framework is built upon the scalable and efficient infrastructure developed for DeepSeek-V3 (DeepSeek-AI, 2024c)
a9b331777be75f079bbdc0ec0919ca99.z: 我们的训练框架基于为DeepSeek-V3（DeepSeek-AI，2024c）开发的可扩展且高效的基础设施构建。

034f1a3c8702c1ea19b490cab6e20acc.t: In training DeepSeek-V4, we inherit this robust foundation while introducing several key innovations to accommodate its novel architectural components — specifically the Muon optimizer, mHC, and the hybrid attention mechanism — while maintaining high training efficiency and stability
034f1a3c8702c1ea19b490cab6e20acc.z: 在训练DeepSeek-V4时，我们继承了这一坚实基础，同时引入多项关键创新，以适应其新颖的架构组件——具体包括Muon优化器、mHC及混合注意力机制——并保持高训练效率与稳定性。

a65174a5423da0697edbcf2278dc144b.t: For dense parameters, we limit the maximum size of ZeRO parallelism and employ a knapsack algorithm to assign parameter matrices to these ranks, ensuring each rank manages a roughly balanced load
a65174a5423da0697edbcf2278dc144b.z: 对于密集参数，我们限制ZeRO并行的最大规模，并采用背包算法将参数矩阵分配给这些秩，确保每个秩管理的负载大致均衡。

a2c4d7d0674ecfcbaf9312aa6969065b.t: For MoE parameters, we optimize each expert independently
a2c4d7d0674ecfcbaf9312aa6969065b.z: 对于MoE参数，我们独立优化每个专家。

6e61b4d2865da926a75926a1c6717ada.t: The bucket on each rank is padded to match the size of the largest bucket across ranks, facilitating efficient reduce-scatter operations
6e61b4d2865da926a75926a1c6717ada.z: 每个等级上的桶都会被填充，以匹配所有等级中最大桶的大小，从而便于高效的reduce-scatter操作。

a6cd3ebba897a98b06fcc629dda5e52a.t: This padding typically incurs less than 10% memory overhead in our setup, where each rank manages no more than five parameter matrices
a6cd3ebba897a98b06fcc629dda5e52a.z: 在我们的配置中，每个秩管理的参数矩阵不超过五个，这种填充通常带来的内存开销不到10%。

23a8be824d6a78f28a49f647fe65c599.t: We first flatten all down projection matrices in SwiGLU (Shazeer, 2020) of all experts across all layers, followed by flattened up projection matrices and gate matrices
23a8be824d6a78f28a49f647fe65c599.z: 我们首先将所有层中所有专家的SwiGLU（Shazeer, 2020）下投影矩阵展平，随后展平上投影矩阵和门控矩阵。

2ac6ac58ddc60f3b47e6733d12b36767.t: When the overall size of data parallelism exceeds the limit for ZeRO, we compute the Muon update redundantly across the extra data-parallel groups, trading computation for reduced total bucket memory
2ac6ac58ddc60f3b47e6733d12b36767.z: 当数据并行的整体规模超过ZeRO的限制时，我们在额外的数据并行组中冗余计算Muon更新，以计算换取总桶内存的减少。

ddd3b5adf4ac186614b790cd6d360fc1.t: Given the large number of experts, we do not impose a limit of ZeRO parallelism for MoE parameters, and the padding overhead is also negligible
ddd3b5adf4ac186614b790cd6d360fc1.z: 鉴于专家数量众多，我们对MoE参数不设ZeRO并行度限制，填充开销亦可忽略不计。

2e7d142f3c6fc63083a5bd103c4b1db2.t: Then, we pad the flattened vector to ensure we can evenly distribute this vector across all ranks without splitting any logically independent matrix
2e7d142f3c6fc63083a5bd103c4b1db2.z: 然后，我们对展平后的向量进行填充，以确保能够在不分割任何逻辑独立矩阵的情况下，将该向量均匀分配到所有秩中。

5217409e13558f286ffb1a2767455351.t: Additionally, on each rank, consecutive parameters of identical shape will be automatically merged, enabling batched execution of the Newton-Schulz iterations for better hardware utilization
5217409e13558f286ffb1a2767455351.z: 此外，在每个秩上，形状相同的连续参数将自动合并，从而支持牛顿-舒尔茨迭代的批量执行，以提升硬件利用率。

e75c0adb6384bcd947d6033a562ddac9.t: Leveraging this, we further quantize, in a stochastic rounding manner, the MoE gradients to be synchronized across data-parallel ranks to the BF16 precision, halving the communication volume
e75c0adb6384bcd947d6033a562ddac9.z: 利用这一点，我们进一步以随机舍入方式，将需跨数据并行等级同步的MoE梯度量化至BF16精度，使通信量减半。

d2bb885b9c9d856d16462cd6d72f451a.t: Furthermore, we observe that the Newton-Schulz iterations in Muon remain stable when computed with BF16 matrix multiplications
d2bb885b9c9d856d16462cd6d72f451a.z: 此外，我们观察到Muon中的Newton-Schulz迭代在使用BF16矩阵乘法计算时保持稳定。

b44032da2e864bfeb039ae7dfc357837.t: First, an all-to-all operation exchanges local gradients across ranks, and then each rank performs a local sum in FP32
b44032da2e864bfeb039ae7dfc357837.z: 首先，执行一次全对全操作以在各等级间交换本地梯度，随后每个等级在FP32精度下进行本地求和。

b84e77c1cd57fe8cc77c74ff308eeb08.t: To avoid accumulation errors introduced by low-precision adders, we replace conventional tree- or ring-based reduce-scatter collectives with a two-phase approach
b84e77c1cd57fe8cc77c74ff308eeb08.z: 为避免低精度加法器引入的累积误差，我们采用两阶段方法替代传统的基于树或环的归约散播集合操作。

6cab1c33bd7e1281a486cfeefea925f5.z: 该设计保持了数值稳健性。

23faeef80640df13f2bcbca80ac0544a.t: To mitigate these costs, we implement several optimization strategies
23faeef80640df13f2bcbca80ac0544a.z: 为降低这些成本，我们实施了多项优化策略。

1d472a69a338771afc8e6f5cd2edf593.t: The introduction of mHC increases both activation memory consumption and communication volume between pipeline stages, compared with conventional residual connections
1d472a69a338771afc8e6f5cd2edf593.z: 与传统的残差连接相比，引入mHC增加了激活内存消耗以及流水线各阶段之间的通信量。

9dda50ed18ca3f9ba45be92fb2ed8dbe.t: Firstly, we carefully design and implement fused kernels of mHC for both training and inference
9dda50ed18ca3f9ba45be92fb2ed8dbe.z: 首先，我们为mHC精心设计并实现了训练与推理的融合内核。

a0e795fc4df54cbc8cbee7d0a277af94.t: Secondly, we introduce a recomputation strategy that selectively checkpoints intermediate tensors
a0e795fc4df54cbc8cbee7d0a277af94.z: 其次，我们引入了一种重计算策略，该策略选择性地检查中间张量。

409097288f1eb78c1a6d7fc63051ed7d.t: This achieves a balance between memory saving and computational overhead
409097288f1eb78c1a6d7fc63051ed7d.z: 这在内存节省与计算开销之间取得了平衡。

3e968910276f0bd6981c039c02e5bbc4.t: More details of the engineering optimization can be found in the dedicated mHC paper (Xie et al
3e968910276f0bd6981c039c02e5bbc4.z: 工程优化的更多细节可参见专门的mHC论文（Xie等人）。

4460821ea6a0a2447ee15a5a9a168b99.t: Thirdly, we adjust the DualPipe 1F1B overlapping scheme to accommodate the increased pipeline communication and enable concurrent execution of some operations in mHC
4460821ea6a0a2447ee15a5a9a168b99.z: 第三，我们调整了DualPipe 1F1B重叠方案，以适应增多的流水线通信，并实现mHC中部分操作的并发执行。

336fa2ca394e5bf2a766f9b9106cae5f.t: Collectively, these optimizations constrain the wall-time overhead of mHC to only 6.7% of the overlapped 1F1B pipeline stage
336fa2ca394e5bf2a766f9b9106cae5f.z: 总体而言，这些优化将mHC的墙钟时间开销限制在重叠的1F1B流水线阶段的6.7%。

7c4a8dbf2e6d677429b173d74fb4ba54.t: Specifically, we recompute most hidden states between layers and all normalized layer inputs, while avoiding recomputation of compute-intensive operations
7c4a8dbf2e6d677429b173d74fb4ba54.z: 具体而言，我们重新计算层间大部分隐藏状态及所有归一化层输入，同时避免重复计算计算密集型操作。

7aacf5770607c29e4972b17ff0cf8692.t: Conventional Context Parallelism (CP) partitions the sequence dimension, with each rank maintaining contiguous $s$ tokens
7aacf5770607c29e4972b17ff0cf8692.z: 传统上下文并行（CP）沿序列维度进行划分，每个秩保持连续的$s$个令牌。

60700ee3608c70faa2043be624c23ddc.t: This introduces two challenges to our compressed attention mechanisms (i
60700ee3608c70faa2043be624c23ddc.z: 这为我们的压缩注意力机制带来了两个挑战。

ec865ae50a86628b9ce2ae603069b0e8.t: On the one hand, training samples are packed from multiple sequences, and each sequence is compressed independently by a factor of $m$ (or $m^{\prime}$), with any trailing tokens fewer than $m$ being discarded
ec865ae50a86628b9ce2ae603069b0e8.z: 一方面，训练样本由多个序列打包而成，每个序列独立压缩因子为$m$（或$m^{\prime}$），不足$m$的尾部标记将被丢弃。

6a767d09c0b58f3f2a9443245ab488bb.t: On the other hand, the compression requires $m$ consecutive KV entries, which may straddle the boundary between two neighboring CP ranks
6a767d09c0b58f3f2a9443245ab488bb.z: 另一方面，压缩需要$m$个连续的KV条目，这些条目可能跨越两个相邻CP等级之间的边界。

9e6d47881e13dabc98c30838bea5d22c.t: To address these challenges, we design a two-stage communication approach
9e6d47881e13dabc98c30838bea5d22c.z: 为应对这些挑战，我们设计了一种两阶段通信方法。

65d0cc18cced77b2c4ffe72e5148ce5d.t: Consequently, the compressed KV lengths are typically less than $\frac{s}{m}$ and vary across ranks
65d0cc18cced77b2c4ffe72e5148ce5d.z: 因此，压缩后的KV长度通常小于$\frac{s}{m}$，且在不同秩间有所变化。

25bbe63874b0c796631cc2b86468f0c1.t: In the first stage, each rank $i$ sends its last $m$ uncompressed KV entries to rank $i+1$
25bbe63874b0c796631cc2b86468f0c1.z: 在第一阶段，每个等级$i$将其最后$m$个未压缩的KV条目发送给等级$i+1$。

ef00c296ed11781e7cf34aa09b7ea3d5.t: Then, a fused select-and-pad operator reorganizes them into the full set of compressed KV entries with a total length of $\texttt{cp\_size}\cdot\frac{s}{m}$
ef00c296ed11781e7cf34aa09b7ea3d5.z: 随后，一个融合的“选择并填充”算子将它们重组为完整的压缩KV条目集，总长度为$\texttt{cp\_size}\cdot\frac{s}{m}$。

fca16cfa6f6da7a5d29fd4e4cd4368d4.t: In the second stage, an all-gather operation across all CP ranks collects the locally compressed KV entries
fca16cfa6f6da7a5d29fd4e4cd4368d4.z: 在第二阶段，跨所有CP秩的全收集操作会汇集本地压缩的KV条目。

196b2aebfb8082eea39642725793d94e.t: Then, rank $i+1$ compresses some of these received entries together with its local $s$ uncompressed KV entries, producing a fixed length of $\frac{s}{m}+1$ compressed entries, in which exist some padding entries
196b2aebfb8082eea39642725793d94e.z: 然后，第 $i+1$ 层将其接收到的部分条目与本地 $s$ 个未压缩的 KV 条目一起压缩，生成固定长度为 $\frac{s}{m}+1$ 的压缩条目，其中包含一些填充条目。

a699a844951dc0958c475f76a3839d63.t: For the sparse attention in CSA, the top-$k$ selector explicitly specifies the indices of visible compressed KV entries for each query
a699a844951dc0958c475f76a3839d63.z: 对于CSA中的稀疏注意力，top-$k$选择器明确指定了每个查询可见的压缩KV条目的索引。

7836bf0d64ad38e6701677f14a14ab55.t: Any padding entries are placed at the tail
7836bf0d64ad38e6701677f14a14ab55.z: 任何填充条目均置于尾部。

3c447f888a2b2e1a055041e8c076d48b.t: Conventional activation checkpointing implementations operate at the granularity of an entire module, deciding whether to retain or recompute its output activations during the backward pass
3c447f888a2b2e1a055041e8c076d48b.z: 传统激活检查点实现以整个模块为粒度，决定在反向传播过程中是保留还是重新计算其输出激活。

95d648e1e76eec216b98ce599f7858ba.t: For HCA and the indexer in CSA, the visible range of compressed KV entries for each query token can be precomputed by rules
95d648e1e76eec216b98ce599f7858ba.z: 对于HCA及CSA中的索引器，每个查询令牌的压缩KV条目可见范围可通过规则预先计算。

af132e167e0000bcba3b6d12f38b3d1e.t: An alternative approach is to manually implement the forward and backward logic of an entire layer, explicitly managing tensor checkpointing states
af132e167e0000bcba3b6d12f38b3d1e.z: 另一种方法是手动实现整个层的前向与后向逻辑，并显式管理张量检查点状态。

dc59a001c790e39b41ee9a8799d53a2b.t: This coarse granularity often leads to suboptimal trade-offs between recomputation cost and activation memory footprint
dc59a001c790e39b41ee9a8799d53a2b.z: 这种粗粒度往往导致在重计算成本与激活内存占用之间难以达到最优权衡。

47506b186612f9ae33bfc0c049a4dc12.t: Therefore, we sought to tackle this issue from two dimensions: breaking the vicious cycle induced by routing, and directly suppressing anomalous values
47506b186612f9ae33bfc0c049a4dc12.z: 因此，我们从两个维度着手解决这一问题：打破路由引发的恶性循环，并直接抑制异常值。

56df3e0bcddfe721b8fa37e8e94300f9.t: Fortunately, we discovered two practical techniques that effectively maintain training stability
56df3e0bcddfe721b8fa37e8e94300f9.z: 幸运的是，我们发现了两种能有效维持训练稳定性的实用技术。

838ee5135aeb932d5d75c79a5cb97510.t: Empirically, we identified that the occurrence of spikes is consistently tied to outliers in the MoE layers, and the routing mechanism itself appears to exacerbate the emergence of these outliers
838ee5135aeb932d5d75c79a5cb97510.z: 实验上，我们发现尖峰的出现始终与MoE层中的离群值相关，而路由机制本身似乎加剧了这些离群值的产生。

33116f25f9f799ea5b82d33281686921.t: Compared with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro starts with a longer stage of dense attention, and the strategy of introducing sparse attention is the same as DeepSeek-V4-Flash, following a two-stage training method
33116f25f9f799ea5b82d33281686921.z: 与DeepSeek-V4-Flash相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro起始阶段采用更长的密集注意力阶段，引入稀疏注意力的策略与DeepSeek-V4-Flash相同，遵循两阶段训练方法。

604cecec9dadf3f053f65069f5f37054.t: We found that decoupling the synchronous updates of the backbone network and the routing network significantly improves training stability
604cecec9dadf3f053f65069f5f37054.z: 我们发现，将骨干网络与路由网络的同步更新解耦，能显著提升训练稳定性。

931cf6fde494bb2c5297617cb64e3b05.t: Although a comprehensive theoretical understanding of their underlying mechanisms remains an open question for now, we are sharing them openly to foster further exploration by the community

6a7017bd4f294a35b04a20a9af254f25.t: In practice, to circumvent the overhead of loading model parameters twice, we fetch the data for step $t$ in advance at step $t-\Delta t$
6a7017bd4f294a35b04a20a9af254f25.z: 实际上，为避免两次加载模型参数的开销，我们在步骤$t-\Delta t$时预先获取步骤$t$所需的数据。

d29df936e64ffddb687bcb1cb497bf50.t: Consequently, at step $t$, we use the current network parameters $\theta_{t}$ for feature computation, but the routing indices are computed and applied using the historical network parameters $\theta_{t-\Delta t}$
d29df936e64ffddb687bcb1cb497bf50.z: 因此，在步骤$t$中，我们使用当前网络参数$\theta_{t}$进行特征计算，而路由索引则基于历史网络参数$\theta_{t-\Delta t}$计算并应用。

02d10085221eeb65bdbefe4bc3343a9a.t: Second, we introduced an automatic detection mechanism that triggers a short rollback and activates Anticipatory Routing exclusively when a loss spike occurs; after operating in this mode for a certain period, the system reverts to standard training
02d10085221eeb65bdbefe4bc3343a9a.z: 其次，我们引入了一种自动检测机制，仅在出现丢包激增时触发短暂回滚并激活预期路由；在该模式运行一段时间后，系统恢复至标准训练。

122da777094ac85dfbb3583eaa13dbca.t: First, given that pre-computing the routing indices only requires a single forward pass over the data, we carefully orchestrated the pipeline execution and the overlapping of computation with Expert Parallelism (EP) communication, successfully bounding the additional wall-clock time overhead of Anticipatory Routing to approximately 20%
122da777094ac85dfbb3583eaa13dbca.z: 首先，鉴于预计算路由索引仅需对数据进行一次前向传播，我们精心编排了流水线执行及计算与专家并行（EP）通信的重叠，成功将预期路由的额外墙钟时间开销控制在约20%以内。

7012c118c52171ee2bc1b5cd1f2a5451.t: Ultimately, this dynamic application allows us to avert loss spikes with negligible overall additional training overhead, all without compromising model performance
7012c118c52171ee2bc1b5cd1f2a5451.z: 最终，这一动态应用使我们能够避免损失激增，且总体额外训练开销可忽略不计，同时不损害模型性能。

d05589e0fbfbae24aa0d62088a62b83b.t: We "anticipatorily" compute and cache the routing indices to be used later at step $t$, which is why we name this approach Anticipatory Routing
d05589e0fbfbae24aa0d62088a62b83b.z: 我们“预先”计算并缓存将在步骤$t$使用的路由索引，因此将此方法命名为“预期路由”。

f21f5534921afe95318ccd1ec14fa8a9.z: 这确保了采样过程中的模型行为与在线部署完全一致，同时减少了内核内存加载以实现实际加速，并显著降低了内存消耗。

a5d92c63c5daeb69480289dcb7bc0c7e.z: 在RL训练中不涉及反向传播的推理和 rollout 阶段，我们直接使用原生FP4量化权重，而非模拟量化。

b055905c5f74978c8cb5f3b542d54d85.t: This design incurs negligible recomputation overhead while completely circumventing the memory burden associated with explicit logits materialization
b055905c5f74978c8cb5f3b542d54d85.z: 该设计在完全规避显式logits物化相关内存负担的同时，引入了可忽略不计的重新计算开销。

1ad9a36e05f24eda944bb9eca246139c.z: 在训练时，这些缓存状态被检索并通过相应的预测头模块传递，以即时重建完整的逻辑值。

68117a5c1f7ef42b489810e5486ead22.z: 此外，即使将词汇量$|V|>100\text{k}$的logits天真地物化到磁盘上，对所有教师而言也是不可行的。

476ce75321c2cda93dfcd7ab9fa812bf.t: To maximize GPU resource utilization while enabling rapid hardware provisioning for high-priority tasks, our GPU cluster employs a cluster-wide preemptive task scheduler, where any running task may be preempted at any time

8b27546091297b1a25a11086b949f5b6.t: Finally, the exact KL divergences between teacher and student logits are computed using a specialized TileLang kernel, which accelerates the computation and curtails dynamic memory allocation
8b27546091297b1a25a11086b949f5b6.z: 最后，教师与学生logits之间的精确KL散度通过专门的TileLang内核计算，该内核加速了计算过程并减少了动态内存分配。

e15144ad426b084423ebb9690e32ecc3.t: During preemption, we pause the inference engine and save the KV cache of unfinished requests
e15144ad426b084423ebb9690e32ecc3.z: 在抢占过程中，我们暂停推理引擎并保存未完成请求的KV缓存。

b2d207b066a9c6a9cf9a74669dfe885e.t: Whenever a new token is generated for a request, we immediately append it to that request’s WAL
b2d207b066a9c6a9cf9a74669dfe885e.z: 每当为请求生成新令牌时，我们会立即将其追加到该请求的WAL中。

54dc32eca6fab03a1194c3edb90c3778.t: Importantly, it is mathematically incorrect to regenerate unfinished requests from scratch, as this introduces length bias

41a3b0fbc82d926972bc9be78f86048a.t: Upon resumption, we use the persisted WALs and saved KV cache to continue decoding
41a3b0fbc82d926972bc9be78f86048a.z: 恢复后，我们使用持久化的WAL和保存的KV缓存继续解码。

920f7c5b9f4b251119a2507e57216227.t: Even when a fatal hardware error occurs, we can re-run the prefill phase using the persisted tokens in WAL to reconstruct the KV cache
920f7c5b9f4b251119a2507e57216227.z: 即使发生致命硬件错误，我们也能利用WAL中持久化的令牌重新执行预填充阶段，以重建KV缓存。

bd7f190c1ac5720cc2d7116d40adf415.t: If the inference stack is batch-invariant and deterministic, this correctness issue could also be addressed by regenerating with a consistent seed for the pseudorandom number generator used in the sampler
bd7f190c1ac5720cc2d7116d40adf415.z: 如果推理栈是批处理不变的且确定性的，这一正确性问题也可以通过为采样器中使用的伪随机数生成器设置一致的种子并重新生成来解决。

f5d3f28812fc67858623d0f788209e94.t: During the rollout phase, we adopt a preemptible and fault-tolerant rollout service, detailed in Section 5.2
f5d3f28812fc67858623d0f788209e94.z: 在推广阶段，我们采用可抢占且容错的推广服务，详见第5.2节。

14d5fcf6881ad37e38ca6a0385281f8e.t: However, this approach still incurs the extra cost of re-running the decoding phase, making it far less efficient than our token-granular WAL method
14d5fcf6881ad37e38ca6a0385281f8e.z: 然而，这种方法仍需额外付出重新运行解码阶段的成本，使其效率远不及我们基于令牌粒度的WAL方法。

39d7cfb6d56e49e6e54c2bde3a66c527.t: Because shorter responses are more likely to survive interruption, regenerating from scratch makes the model more prone to producing shorter sequences whenever an interruption occurs
39d7cfb6d56e49e6e54c2bde3a66c527.z: 由于较短的回复更可能在被打断时幸存下来，从头重新生成会使模型在遇到中断时更倾向于生成较短的序列。

14093c7592d188e059d55af94fd7da6a.t: For the inference and training phase, we decompose the rollout data format into lightweight metadata and heavy per-token fields
14093c7592d188e059d55af94fd7da6a.z: 在推理和训练阶段，我们将回放数据格式分解为轻量级元数据和重量级逐令牌字段。

6001c5a8b8dbde1574014f9cff536d10.t: In production, a single DSec cluster manages hundreds of thousands of concurrent sandbox instances
6001c5a8b8dbde1574014f9cff536d10.z: 在生产环境中，单个DSec集群管理着数十万个并发沙箱实例。

1369d60f07787af35e1719b6eef15b14.t: We introduce targeted optimizations for efficient RL and OPD on million-token sequences
1369d60f07787af35e1719b6eef15b14.z: 我们针对百万级token序列上的高效RL与OPD，引入了定向优化措施。

59128fdaea41262ec19245184a4efe07.t: During data dispatching, the metadata for the entire rollout data can be loaded to perform global shuffling and packing layout computation
59128fdaea41262ec19245184a4efe07.z: 在数据分发过程中，可加载整个发布数据的元数据，以执行全局洗牌和打包布局计算。

31836c526d62f95ad8f1cf88f2464b67.t: Heavy per-token fields are loaded via a shared-memory data loader to eliminate intra-node data redundancy and are released immediately upon consumption at the mini-batch granularity, substantially reducing both CPU and GPU memory pressure
31836c526d62f95ad8f1cf88f2464b67.z: 重型的每令牌字段通过共享内存数据加载器加载，以消除节点内数据冗余，并在小批量粒度上消费后立即释放，从而大幅降低CPU和GPU内存压力。

f45effc218c81332dddb523380af03a2.t: To meet the diverse execution demands of agentic AI during post-training and evaluation, we build a production-grade sandbox platform, DeepSeek Elastic Compute (DSec)
f45effc218c81332dddb523380af03a2.z: 为满足智能体AI在训练后与评估阶段多样化的执行需求，我们构建了生产级沙箱平台——DeepSeek弹性计算（DSec）。

19119a815f3f4dd9af31641783d8bc7c.t: DSec comprises three Rust components — the API gateway (Apiserver), per-host agent (Edge), and the cluster monitor (Watcher) — that are interconnected by a custom RPC protocol and scale horizontally atop the 3FS distributed filesystem (DeepSeek-AI, 2025c)
19119a815f3f4dd9af31641783d8bc7c.z: DSec由三个Rust组件构成——API网关（Apiserver）、每主机代理（Edge）和集群监控器（Watcher）——它们通过自定义RPC协议相互连接，并在3FS分布式文件系统之上水平扩展（DeepSeek-AI，2025c）。

5b753ef6d0da693ed6495bda427a0197.t: The number of on-device mini-batches is dynamically determined based on workload, allowing an efficient trade-off between computational throughput and I/O overlap
5b753ef6d0da693ed6495bda427a0197.z: 设备端小批次数目根据工作负载动态确定，从而在计算吞吐量与I/O重叠之间实现高效权衡。

afa9995f51d4943f78959d3069a7dcd8.t: Function Call dispatches stateless invocations to a pre-warmed container pool, eliminating cold-start overhead
afa9995f51d4943f78959d3069a7dcd8.z: 函数调用将无状态调用分发至预热的容器池，消除了冷启动开销。

f2f8330011a67f19c9d3a4bce3a2e00f.z: 基于上述观察，我们将在下文逐一阐述DSec的四大核心设计。

44b5793f3b6ffe61a4d4b5b1762b9da8.z: 容器完全兼容Docker，并利用EROFS（Gao等人）技术。

b3f99e39418b053a385c9acabd615469.t: DSec exposes a single Python SDK (libdsec) that abstracts four execution substrates
b3f99e39418b053a385c9acabd615469.z: DSec提供了一个统一的Python SDK（libdsec），抽象了四种执行底层。

9dc7f67d9923920eb7d37dc3ca280a88.t: The design of DSec is motivated by four observations: (1) agentic workloads are highly heterogeneous, spanning lightweight function calls to full software-engineering pipelines with diverse OS and security requirements; (2) environment images are numerous and large, yet must load quickly and support iterative customization; (3) high-density deployment demands efficient CPU and memory utilization; (4) sandbox lifecycles must coordinate with GPU training schedules, including preemption and checkpoint-based resumption
9dc7f67d9923920eb7d37dc3ca280a88.z: DSec的设计基于以下四个观察：(1)代理型工作负载高度异构，涵盖从轻量级函数调用到完整软件工程流水线，且具有多样的操作系统和安全需求；(2)环境镜像数量众多且体积庞大，但必须快速加载并支持迭代定制；(3)高密度部署要求高效的CPU和内存利用率；(4)沙箱生命周期需与GPU训练调度协调，包括抢占和基于检查点的恢复。

14be4ab31400eefba9f29c29ca996831.t: fullVM, built on QEMU (Bellard, 2005), supports arbitrary guest operating systems
14be4ab31400eefba9f29c29ca996831.z: fullVM基于QEMU（Bellard，2005）构建，支持任意客户操作系统。

9ed5c5b47f678e845437c5bc6a0f7873.t: All four share a common API surface — command execution, file transfer, and TTY access — and switching between them requires only a parameter change
9ed5c5b47f678e845437c5bc6a0f7873.z: 这四个共享相同的API接口——命令执行、文件传输和TTY访问——在它们之间切换只需更改一个参数。

ddb422464395733c2afabdf3d6dfff3d.t: For containers, base images and filesystem commits are stored as 3FS-backed readonly EROFS layers mounted directly into overlay lowerdirs
ddb422464395733c2afabdf3d6dfff3d.z: 对于容器而言，基础镜像和文件系统提交以3FS支持的只读EROFS层形式存储，直接挂载到overlay的lowerdirs中。

301765ef1f0590645b8e77f854af13a8.t: DSec reconciles fast startup with a large and growing corpus of environment images through layered, on-demand loading
301765ef1f0590645b8e77f854af13a8.z: DSec通过分层按需加载，实现了快速启动与庞大且不断增长的环境镜像库之间的协调。

7c613abed270bc9b797362d942a155cf.t: We keep file metadata readily available on the local disk at mount time; meanwhile, data blocks are fetched from 3FS upon request
7c613abed270bc9b797362d942a155cf.z: 我们将文件元数据在挂载时即保存在本地磁盘上，随时可用；而数据块则按需从3FS获取。

0376df41226396991a72e5f43a9f2929.z: 为支持每个集群数十万个沙箱，DSec解决了两个资源瓶颈。

bca75f9d93a970e965125e4b2ef831d2.t: , 2020) disk format: the read-only base layer resides on 3FS for cross-instance sharing, while writes go to a local copy-on-write layer

c5ceefae7067acaa757f1b4bd3447347.t: Such snapshots are chainable, facilitating efficient versioning and millisecond-scale resumption
c5ceefae7067acaa757f1b4bd3447347.z: 此类快照可链式操作，便于高效版本管理及毫秒级恢复。

a1acbeff2059b0e9e58e6ba7c8a454dc.t: DSec maintains a globally ordered trajectory log for each sandbox, persistently recording every command invocation and its results
a1acbeff2059b0e9e58e6ba7c8a454dc.z: DSec为每个沙箱维护一个全局有序的执行轨迹日志，持久记录每次命令调用及其结果。

9ead3fefcdbb7b9035d822c7ec1ca99c.t: First, it mitigates duplicate page-cache footprints in virtualized environments and applies memory reclamation to enable safe overcommitment
9ead3fefcdbb7b9035d822c7ec1ca99c.z: 首先，它减少了虚拟化环境中重复的页面缓存占用，并应用内存回收以实现安全的超量分配。

20d7d66c75d898912b3fd2e1dd74af79.t: Second, it alleviates spinlock contention in the container runtime and therefore, reduces per-sandbox CPU overhead, significantly increasing per-host packing density
20d7d66c75d898912b3fd2e1dd74af79.z: 其次，它缓解了容器运行时中的自旋锁竞争，从而降低了每个沙箱的CPU开销，显著提升了每台主机的打包密度。

3ff2749e891394eddf58eb30d961f95d.t: The trajectory serves three purposes: (1) client fast-forwarding — when a training task is preempted, sandbox resources are retained nonetheless; upon resumption, DSec replays cached results for previously completed commands, accelerating task recovery whilst also preventing errors from re-execution of non-idempotent operations; (2) fine-grained provenance — the origin and corresponding outcomes of each state change are traceable; (3) deterministic replay — any historical session can be faithfully reproduced from its trajectory
3ff2749e891394eddf58eb30d961f95d.z: 该轨迹有三个用途：（1）客户端快进——当训练任务被抢占时，沙箱资源仍被保留；恢复后，DSec重放先前完成命令的缓存结果，加速任务恢复，同时避免因重新执行非幂等操作而引发错误；（2）细粒度溯源——每个状态变更的来源及对应结果均可追溯；（3）确定性重放——任何历史会话都能从其轨迹中忠实重现。

a3ffcd283368f87a379ef007882720d7.t: The model’s overall rating is the average of these contest-level expected ratings across all 14 contests
a3ffcd283368f87a379ef007882720d7.z: 模型的整体评分是其在全部14场竞赛中竞赛级预期评分的平均值。

97082035d2b9f1f5653d1e35e6cba368.t: For each problem independently, we sample 10 of these solutions without replacement and arrange them in a random order to form the submission sequence
97082035d2b9f1f5653d1e35e6cba368.z: 对于每个问题，我们独立地从这些解决方案中无放回地抽取10个，并随机排列顺序以形成提交序列。

2c4ba5bc86380fe892b6878eb57cba4c.t: The score for a solved problem follows the penalty scheme of OpenAI (2025): the model receives the median score of human participants who solved the same problem with the same number of prior failed attempts
2c4ba5bc86380fe892b6878eb57cba4c.z: 得分遵循OpenAI（2025）的罚分方案：模型获得与相同问题、相同先前失败尝试次数的人类解题者得分的中位数。

dbfd3285fd2faa1bdcfa9d50d6146c31.t: This yields a total contest score for each sampled submission sequence, which is then converted into a contest rank and subsequently into an estimated rating via the standard Codeforces rating system
dbfd3285fd2faa1bdcfa9d50d6146c31.z: 由此得出每个抽样提交序列的总竞赛得分，再转换为竞赛排名，进而通过标准Codeforces评分系统估算出对应评级。

c07c3192ace5a82178b6256ac5f4c46a.t: The contest-level expected rating is defined as the expectation of this estimated rating over all possible random selections and orderings of the 10 submissions per problem
c07c3192ace5a82178b6256ac5f4c46a.z: 竞赛级别的预期评分定义为：对于每个问题随机选取的10份提交及其所有可能排列，该估计评分的期望值。

720eeec0fa40d6837e2a97eaef754d46.z: 该设计采用非正式推理以增强探索性，同时通过形式化验证确保严格正确性。

c0a38702abaf4dc6995372c4c8442571.t: Unlike standard RAG, agentic search empowers the model to iteratively invoke search and fetch tools per query, significantly enhancing overall search performance
c0a38702abaf4dc6995372c4c8442571.z: 与标准RAG不同，智能体搜索使模型能够针对每个查询迭代调用搜索和获取工具，显著提升整体搜索性能。

ab7adca426606e309a09dde4a78d8313.t: As shown in Table 9, agentic search consistently outperforms RAG, particularly on complex tasks
ab7adca426606e309a09dde4a78d8313.z: 如表9所示，智能体搜索在各项任务中均优于RAG，尤其在复杂任务上表现突出。

aba95a0a2a4b29fa726a3b84af95a272.t: To benchmark our coding agent capability, we curate tasks from real internal R&D workloads We collect ${\sim}$200 challenging tasks from 50+ internal engineers, spanning feature development, bug fixing, refactoring, and diagnostics across diverse technology stacks including PyTorch, CUDA, Rust, and C++
aba95a0a2a4b29fa726a3b84af95a272.z: 为了评估我们的编程代理能力，我们从实际内部研发工作中精选任务。我们收集了来自50多名内部工程师的约200个具有挑战性的任务，涵盖功能开发、缺陷修复、重构和诊断，涉及PyTorch、CUDA、Rust和C++等多种技术栈。

ab9dee2b453b3dd4190d7bd106eb2864.t: Respondents find DeepSeek-V4-Pro to deliver satisfactory results across most tasks, but note trivial mistakes, misinterpretation of vague prompts, and occasional over-thinking
ab9dee2b453b3dd4190d7bd106eb2864.z: 受访者认为DeepSeek-V4-Pro在大多数任务上表现令人满意，但指出存在细微错误、对模糊提示的误解，以及偶尔过度思考的问题。

2d741dbd85bb2fcaa413a899ec775398.t: In this work, we present a preview version of DeepSeek-V4 series, aiming at next-generation large language models that break the efficiency barrier of ultra-long-context processing
2d741dbd85bb2fcaa413a899ec775398.z: 在本工作中，我们推出DeepSeek-V4系列的预览版本，旨在打造突破超长上下文处理效率瓶颈的下一代大语言模型。

208bb67187806f82d0b267e972889695.t: As shown in Table 8, DeepSeek-V4-Pro significantly outperforms Claude Sonnet 4.5 and approaches the level of Claude Opus 4.5
208bb67187806f82d0b267e972889695.z: 如表8所示，DeepSeek-V4-Pro显著优于Claude Sonnet 4.5，并接近Claude Opus 4.5的水平。

9d71e00bec5daf2d16d25fec38844aa9.t: By combining a hybrid attention architecture that integrates CSA and HCA, DeepSeek-V4 series achieve a dramatic leap in long-sequence efficiency
9d71e00bec5daf2d16d25fec38844aa9.z: 通过融合CSA与HCA的混合注意力架构，DeepSeek-V4系列在长序列效率上实现了显著飞跃。

3bf8c2a6f2870389e1827a0d8f77c2be.t: It substantially outperforms prior open-source models on knowledge benchmarks, achieves superior reasoning performance close to the frontier proprietary models, and delivers competitive agent capabilities
3bf8c2a6f2870389e1827a0d8f77c2be.z: 它在知识基准测试上大幅超越先前的开源模型，推理性能接近前沿专有模型，并展现出具有竞争力的智能体能力。

8d363f80e30fb6ea9c7aa19b02b6f78a.t: The architectural innovations, together with extensive infrastructure optimization, enable efficient native support for million-token contexts and establish a necessary foundation for future test-time scaling, long-horizon tasks, and emerging paradigms such as online learning
8d363f80e30fb6ea9c7aa19b02b6f78a.z: 架构创新与广泛的基础设施优化相结合，实现了对百万级token上下文的高效原生支持，并为未来的测试时扩展、长周期任务及在线学习等新兴范式奠定了必要基础。

6aeacb9d1394443d099c5d96d37fd941.t: Meanwhile, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Max attains comparable reasoning performance to leading closed models while maintaining a highly cost-efficient architecture
6aeacb9d1394443d099c5d96d37fd941.z: 与此同时，DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Max在保持高成本效益架构的同时，达到了与领先闭源模型相当的推理性能。

2cb9723dd9aac54459c34e82942183f1.t: Evaluation results demonstrate that DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, redefines the state-of-the-art for open models
2cb9723dd9aac54459c34e82942183f1.z: 评估结果表明，DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max作为DeepSeek-V4-Pro的最高推理强度模式，重新定义了开放模型的最先进水平。

c14fb4e1a4b23e49d8ba675e3f93a776.t: In a survey asking DeepSeek developers and researchers ($N=85$) — all with experience of using DeepSeek-V4-Pro for agentic coding in their daily work — whether DeepSeek-V4-Pro is ready to serve as their default and primary coding model compared to other frontier models, 52% said yes, 39% leaned toward yes, and fewer than 9% said no
c14fb4e1a4b23e49d8ba675e3f93a776.z: 在一项针对DeepSeek开发者和研究人员的调查中（N=85），所有受访者均有在日常工作中使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro进行智能体编码的经验。当被问及与其他前沿模型相比，DeepSeek-V4-Pro是否已准备好作为他们的默认首选编码模型时，52%的人表示肯定，39%的人倾向于肯定，而表示否定的人不足9%。

0a10328594b16fef906bd2351baa7546.t: In pursuit of extreme long-context efficiency, DeepSeek-V4 series adopted a bold architectural design
0a10328594b16fef906bd2351baa7546.z: 为追求极致的长上下文效率，DeepSeek-V4系列采用了大胆的架构设计。

5ea5f8306b02b339c5e4154560d4f16e.t: We believe DeepSeek-V4 series usher in a new era of million-length contexts for open models and pave the way toward better efficiency, scale, and intelligence
5ea5f8306b02b339c5e4154560d4f16e.z: 我们相信DeepSeek-V4系列开启了开放模型百万级长上下文的新纪元，为更高的效率、规模和智能铺平了道路。

d64f5797bf0bdf4de927a9e41929f0b1.t: To minimize risk, we retained many preliminarily validated components and tricks, which, while effective, made the architecture relatively complex
d64f5797bf0bdf4de927a9e41929f0b1.z: 为降低风险，我们保留了许多初步验证有效的组件和技巧，这些虽有效，却使架构相对复杂。

3247613f0b385e0dd2427c79bb75b94f.t: In future iterations, we will carry out more comprehensive and principled investigations to distill the architecture down to its most essential designs, making it more elegant without sacrificing performance
3247613f0b385e0dd2427c79bb75b94f.z: 在未来的迭代中，我们将开展更全面、更有原则性的研究，以提炼架构至其最核心的设计，使其在不牺牲性能的前提下更加优雅。

6cdf257f955b80892a8540e6c61863b8.z: （2026年）——以在不牺牲能力的前提下进一步提升计算与内存效率。

782c7edc52b9f2a724da94c11d6f69d1.t: Furthermore, we recognize the importance and practical value of long-horizon, multi-round agentic tasks, and will continue to iterate and explore in this direction
782c7edc52b9f2a724da94c11d6f69d1.z: 此外，我们认识到长周期、多轮智能体任务的重要性和实用价值，并将继续在这一方向上迭代与探索。

840af7dc5c9374390cf6b570eb12cca2.t: We will also continuously investigate low-latency architectures and system techniques to make long-context deployment and interaction more responsive
840af7dc5c9374390cf6b570eb12cca2.z: 我们也将持续研究低延迟架构与系统技术，使长上下文部署和交互更加灵敏。

8d5e3c353d9493099ad9068aeb40e004.t: We are also working on incorporating multimodal capabilities to our models
8d5e3c353d9493099ad9068aeb40e004.z: 我们也在致力于为模型加入多模态能力。

cfa8ad43afa104080e58efb9dc1ab1d1.t: Finally, we are committed to developing better data curation and synthesis strategies to consistently enhance model intelligence, robustness, and practical usability across an increasingly broad range of scenarios and tasks
cfa8ad43afa104080e58efb9dc1ab1d1.z: 最后，我们致力于开发更优的数据整理与合成策略，以持续提升模型的智能性、稳健性和实际可用性，覆盖日益广泛的应用场景和任务。
